name: PriorityInputControl
description: Chooses which command request wins when several sources can operate one CM (priority matrix, re-press rule, auto override). Configure its rows in the Builder; wire OUT.set_on and OUT.set_off to the target CM with Direct wires.

CMD.name: auto_active
CMD.description: Auto is active; wire it Direct from the Unit or auto function

OUT.name: set_on
OUT.description: Winning on request (start, open, enable, up)

OUT.name: set_off
OUT.description: Winning off request (stop, close, disable, down)

SET.name: output_kind
SET.description: Pulse: one cycle when a request wins. Level: on while the winning request is held.

STS.name: active_input
STS.description: Row that last won (1 = first row, 0 = none)

STS.name: override
STS.description: An Override row acts while auto is active
